findings.evidence: `upstream/Physlib/Physlib/Relativity/Tensors/RealTensor/Vector/Basic.lean:414` `def ofTemporalComponent {d : ℕ} : ℝ →L[ℝ] Vector d where toFun xt := xt • basis (Sum.inl 0)` and `:421` `def ofSpatialComponent ... toFun xs := ∑ i, xs i • basis (Sum.inr i)`; grep of `./upstream/Physlib` for `timeComponent_ofTemporalComponent|spatialPart_ofTemporalComponent|timeComponent_sub|spatialPart_sub` returns no matches, and the only `ofTemporalComponent` hits are the definition and four use sites. The equality holds componentwise: both sides are `0` at `Sum.inl 0` and `v (Sum.inr i)` at `Sum.inr i`. The repo already records this missing-constructor API as a workaround at `EpsilonEridani/Relativity/Tensors/RealTensor/Vector/MinkowskiProductExtensions.lean:90-93`.
findings.fix: Add in this file the public simp lemmas for the pieces: `timeComponent_ofTemporalComponent (t : ℝ) : (ofTemporalComponent t (d := d)).timeComponent = t`, `spatialPart_ofTemporalComponent : (ofTemporalComponent t (d := d)).spatialPart = 0` (or a single `ofTemporalComponent_apply` on `Sum.inl`/`Sum.inr`), plus `sub_ofTemporalComponent_timeComponent_eq_ofSpatialComponent_spatialPart (v : Vector d) : v - ofTemporalComponent v.timeComponent = ofSpatialComponent v.spatialPart`; then derive `timeComponent_sub_ofTemporalComponent` and `spatialPart_sub_ofTemporalComponent` from them instead of unfolding, which also removes the simp-normal-form obstruction.
findings.issue: The equal-time projection is published only as the bare term `v - ofTemporalComponent v.timeComponent` (also lines 57, 64 and `QFT/Lattice/Continuation/Basic.lean:343`), while Physlib's `ofTemporalComponent` has no API at all: no `ofTemporalComponent_apply`, `timeComponent_ofTemporalComponent`, or `spatialPart_ofTemporalComponent`, and no lemma identifying the projection with the other canonical spelling `ofSpatialComponent v.spatialPart`. Consequently both proofs here must unfold the Physlib definition (`simp [timeComponent, ofTemporalComponent, basis_apply]` at line 53, `simp [ofTemporalComponent, basis_apply]` at line 60), the documented simp-nf obstruction at lines 49-50 exists only because the applied form `ofTemporalComponent t (Sum.inl 0)` has no simp lemma, and `ofMinkowski_sub_ofTemporalComponent_mem_euclideanSection` does not apply to a purely spatial vector written as `ofSpatialComponent v.spatialPart`.

summary: Exposure, bodies, and the wickRotation/euclideanSection characteristic API are in good shape, and the prior round's two findings are met. The remaining gap is the equal-time projection: it is published as the bare term `v - ofTemporalComponent v.timeComponent` with no component lemmas for `ofTemporalComponent` itself and no link to the equally canonical `ofSpatialComponent v.spatialPart`.
